Priya S.: Quick PTO policy question 1: does unused sick time roll over like PTO?
Elena (People Ops): Short answer: no, sick accruals do not carry over. Sick balance resets per policy at year-end.
Omar K.: Wait, so if I have 24h sick left at Dec 31 it disappears?
Elena (People Ops): Correct for standard sick bank. We do keep a separate short-term disability and medical leave tracker which is unaffected. If youre on approved leave, we handle that case-by-case.
Priya S.: Okay. PTO carryover then 2: what's the cap this year?
Elena (People Ops): PTO carryover cap is 40 hours for full-time employees. Its prorated for part-time by your FTE percentage. Use-by date for carried hours is March 31 next year.
Sam T.: Any exceptions for people who were on parental leave and couldn't take time off?
Elena (People Ops): Yes 2: parents returning from approved parental leave can request a one-time extension for carryover. Need a manager note + email to people-ops. We typically allow extension until June 30 for verified cases.
Omar K.: Is there a formal template for that extension request?
Elena (People Ops): Please email people-ops@redwood.com with subject: "PTO Carryover Extension 2- <Name>" and include dates of leave, remaining hours, and manager acknowledgment. Well update Rippling manually if approved.
Priya S.: Are there any December blackout windows this year? Our team has a final release on Dec 22.
Elena (People Ops): We have a soft blackout Dec 182	6 Jan 2 for company-wide events and staffing. Soft means not prohibited, but managers should coordinate coverage. If your role is on the release rota, manager approval needs to confirm coverage.
Sam T.: If someone needs urgent five days off during the soft blackout (family emergency), what's the escalation?
Elena (People Ops): Emergency leaves are granted; managers approve as usual and inform people-ops. For critical roles, manager should propose coverage or a shift swap. If coverage can't be found, escalate to director + people-ops for guidance.
Omar K.: How does Rippling show carryover? Do I need to enter anything?
Elena (People Ops): Rippling shows your accrued balance. We perform year-end processing: up to 40h moves automatically to the next year as "carried PTO." For approved extensions or exceptions we update balances manually and notify payroll.
Priya S.: Can managers pre-approve carryover at headcount review time so people don't have to file later?
Elena (People Ops): Managers can flag probable carryovers in the headcount/people check-in, but official approval still needs the email to people-ops if its above 40h or an extension.
Sam T.: Any blackout for new hire PTO accruals? Like people who start late Nov — do they get prorated carryover?
Elena (People Ops): Yes, accruals are prorated by start date and FTE. Someone who starts Nov 15 will have prorated accruals and the same 40h carry cap applied proportionally by FTE.
